def test_apnumber_various_inputs():
    # numeric strings that can be converted to int
    assert apnumber('5') == 'five'
    # numeric strings that cannot be converted to int remain unchanged
    assert apnumber('5.0') == '5.0'
    assert apnumber('abc') == 'abc'
    assert apnumber('5abc') == '5abc'
    # None should be converted to its string representation
    assert apnumber(None) == 'None'
    # floats
    assert apnumber(3.7) == 'three'           # truncates to integer 3
